Chapter 874: Chapter 15 ‘The Might of the World’ (Please Subscribe)

The first large-scale war after the super-scale battlefield was established, similarly received the utmost attention from all twelve-step ultimate beings.

“Insect Race’s Nightmare Realm was refined from the twelve-step soul treasure, the Nightmare Heart.”

“The Nightmare Heart originally drifted from the Chaos Void into the universe, falling into the hands of the Insect Race’s Myriad Transformation Queen.”

“With the Nightmare Heart as the main material, the refined Nightmare Realm… has an inconceivable suppressive effect on the soul.”

The twelve-step ultimate beings watched the core battlefield and exchanged their thoughts.

The Nightmare Heart is fundamentally not a treasure that the universe can nurture; it comes from the even more vast Chaos Void, innately suppressing any soul power.

The Insect Race’s Myriad Transformation Queen, with tremendous effort and the assistance of many auxiliary materials, was able to forge the Nightmare Realm.

This Clan Suppression Weapon in the hands of the Insect Queen can unleash power that doesn’t fall short of the ‘Void Realm World’ of human civilization.

“Nightmare Realm?”

Xia Qin, among the nine human civilization supremes, glanced at the Insect Race Alliance.

“No worries.”

“The eleventh level cannot manifest much of the Nightmare Realm’s power.”

The hitherto silent Xuanyuan Supreme spoke.

The more powerful the supreme weapon, the higher the requirements for the user.

Like the Nightmare Realm and the Angel Crown, such Clan Suppression Weapons,

if controlled by Level Eleven beings by some ‘shortcut,’

can display power just a bit stronger than ordinary supreme weapons.

Among the various treasures bestowed by Xuanyuan Supreme to Xuanyuan You,

If not to crush the Nightmare Realm, at least resisting it wouldn’t be a problem.

Long before the super-scale battlefield was established,

human civilization had already made many simulation predictions.

They anticipated the tactics of the other eleven peak race forces.

The Nightmare Realm of the Insect Race was completely within expectations.

“But… Galaxy Master…”

Xuanyuan Supreme felt a bit puzzled.

However,

The next moment.

A figure plummeted into the center of the battlefield where humans and the Insect Race were slaughtering each other.

This figure was none other than the Galaxy Master, who with just a light stomp, terrifying space-time fluctuations turned into millstones, ripping apart and grinding many Insect Race Warriors to dust.

The Level Eleven Insect Race Hives, like boats adrift on the sea, were teetering on the edge.

The Insect Race Hive that activated the ‘Nightmare Realm’ deep within the Insect Race Alliance recoiled a great distance.

The ‘palace’ overhead that was continuously emitting null fluctuations also began to spin unexpectedly.

As if it had been subjected to some severe impact.

“This…”

For a moment, all the gazes of the twelve-step ultimate beings converged on the battlefield between human civilization and the Insect Race.

One should know, most twelve-step ultimate beings were focusing on the battlefields of the Robber Clan, the Universe, and other races.

After all, those were the battlefields where the fighting was most fierce,

Especially the Robber Clan, whose strongest Level Eleven alone was suppressing other peak group’s strongest Level Elevens, leaving them with barely any power to retaliate.

Many twelve-step ultimate beings intended to glimpse some tactics of the Robber Clan’s two twelve-step ultimate beings from their strongest Level Eleven.

But now?

“Galaxy Master? Just a stomp, and almost swept through the Insect Race Alliance?”

“Even the Nightmare Realm was impacted, interrupting the soul suppression?”

“What treasure did this Galaxy Master use? Could it be that true heritage of human civilization was brought into the battle?”

The twelve-step ultimate beings looked at each other in disbelief,

At least the power shown by the Galaxy Master was definitely at the level of the Robber Clan’s strongest Level Eleven.

The various races’ strongest Level Elevens, wielding Clan Suppression Weapons, would need nearly ten of them just to barely hold off the Robber Clan’s strongest Level Eleven.

…

In the center of the battlefield between human civilization and the Insect Race,

Lin Yuan looked around, the reason he waited until now to appear was precisely because the grand battlefield had just begun, with many Level Elevens not yet entering Lin Yuan’s killing range.

Here, the killing range meant a radius of seven hundred billion li centered around Lin Yuan.

This is also the limit of the world’s size within Lin Yuan’s body; upon activating Physical Body Divine Ability ‘World,’ within seven hundred billion li, everything is transformed into Lin Yuan’s world.

This isn’t to say Lin Yuan’s attack range is limited to seven hundred billion li.

But beyond this range, there is no certainty of a kill.

After all, a significant number of Level Eleven powerhouses entering the battlefield possess supreme weapons for protection.

Lin Yuan, facing tens of thousands alone, with scattered power, and also separated by a distance of seven hundred billion li,

indeed is unsure of killing a Level Eleven Perfect who is desperately fleeing and protected by a supreme weapon.

But within seven hundred billion li, it’s different.

Within the range of Divine Ability ‘World,’ Lin Yuan’s strength will be deployed to its greatest extent.

“It’s about time.”

Lin Yuan’s mind remained calm, and he also noticed the gaze from tens of thousands of Level Eleven powerhouses.

When he descended just now, merely stomping his foot caused an uproar within the entire Insect Race Alliance, and this scene was also witnessed by other peak races.

Such an overwhelming display of strength left all Level Eleven powerhouses bewildered.

“Divine Ability… World!”

With a slight fluctuation of thought, the imprint of the ‘World’ Divine Ability deep within Lin Yuan’s body suddenly began to vibrate and spread. Strands of world power centered around Lin Yuan instantaneously permeated a range of seven hundred billion li.

Ever since entering the super-scale battlefield, Lin Yuan had been restraining his strength, all for this moment.

If his true strength were exposed too early, how could these powerhouses from all the peak races gather here obediently for Lin Yuan to slaughter?

Although with Lin Yuan present, they would ultimately be able to control the war in the super-scale battlefield.
